stage: Fresh synthetic code-task actor pilot followed by explicitly open-loop ordered retrieval comparisons; official synthetic runner controls precede scoring.
selection: Normalize canonical owner/repo from benchmark fork metadata, preserve Gate24/25 exclusions, all prepared RepoQA/public source families and proactively reserve common human SWE-bench families. Sort remaining canonical families by SHA256; first3 are pilot development, next3 validation. One hash-first instance per family. No task difficulty/problem/patch/test fields in selection.
actor: One current Codex actor uses actual Ixos search/grep/read with explicit optional remembered views, complete source citations and at most16retrieval calls/18000stdout tokens per task. References/tests remain hidden until all selected development submissions are frozen. Submit a concrete source-only repair patch when established; retain abstention/failure and grading errors. No independent multi-agent A/B claim.
sources: Export complete tracked working source from the official buggy task branch, excluding Git history and the failing tests removed upstream. Verify archive paths, hash/byte/inventory identities, no ordinary cache sidecars and original corpus integrity. Patches are applied only in disposable test containers; never mutate source corpora or production Ixos for an actor task.
representation: Current selected code parent, intro-uniform, bounded-rerank, actual JIT/native/resident conditions. No new model or default selection in the actor pilot.
comparison: After submissions freeze, replay observed query/source-inspection sequences against stateless/search-feedback/inspection-feedback and lexical controls. Identical prompts and explicitly shown source views; any replay feedback must remain valid in its own response. Label this open-loop mechanism evaluation; evidence/cost differences are not autonomous task-success A/B.
costs: Record request, stdout, ready and diagnostic tokens separately, tool calls, source/evidence coordinates, startup/first-fill/resident timings with verified cache hits. Agent reasoning is outside the wire-token totals. Do not count repeated commands as new labeled cases.
grading: Official SWE-smith local runner on each frozen actor source-only patch, then localization/diagnosis interpretation with references allowed only after freeze. Verify actual failing/passing tests and environment failures; no solved flag based only on empty-patch behavior. Synthetic pilot is not official human SWE-bench performance or commercial superiority.
limits: Fresh metadata-only validation families remain unopened. No tuning from frozen held-out results, paid APIs, public push/history rewrite/release, new training or forced accepted-file pins. Keep source bytes/ignore policy; no adjacent embedding sidecars. Preserve all failures.
